description: Present value of projected free cash flows plus a Gordon-growth terminal value. Optionally converts enterprise value to an implied share price.

cash.description: Optional: cash and equivalents, for the implied share price

discountRate.description: Discount rate or WACC as a decimal, e.g. 0.09 for 9%

projectedFCF.description: Projected free cash flow for years 1 to N

sharesOutstanding.description: Optional: shares outstanding, for the implied share price

terminalGrowthRate.description: Perpetual growth after year N as a decimal, e.g. 0.025

totalDebt.description: Optional: total debt, for the implied share price

name: dcf_valuation
title: Discounted cash flow (DCF)
